excerpts.label: Early window
excerpts.quote: The protection due to these citizens requiring an effectual interposition in their behalf, a like numver of British prisoners of war were put into confinement, with a notification that they would experience whatever violence might be committed on the American prisoners of war sent to Great Britain.

excerpts.cite: Bill Clinton, State of the Union Address, 1999

fine_topics.name: Crime, Insurrection & Federal Law Enforcement
fine_topics.definition: Suppression of domestic insurrection and combinations against federal law, and the administration of justice through courts, penitentiaries, and law-enforcement agencies.

fine_topics.name: Polygamy in the Territories
fine_topics.definition: Legislation aimed at suppressing polygamy and bigamy in Utah and other Territories through marriage records, witness rules, and voting and office restrictions.

fine_topics.name: Executive Power, Vetoes & the Courts
fine_topics.definition: Assertions of presidential constitutional duties, the veto and removal powers, interbranch relations, and reform of the federal judiciary.
